cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: Joint F, White and quadratic stationary point refit every upstream branch by OLS without checking the declared model_family.
impact: In shipped v1.8.8, a logit/probit/poisson branch followed by these steps completed and persisted linear-model F statistics and p-values under the GLM's provenance.
lesson: OLS-only post-estimation must check the upstream family at the shared refit entry; 9 RED cases (3 families x 3 operations) now pass.

cause: Workflow state persisted only produced_dataset; model steps publish their fitted branches under payload branches, which were dropped from the state record.
impact: A workflow interrupted after estimation could not resume its post-estimation steps; fail-closed, no wrong numbers.
lesson: Every output a later step binds to through depends_on must be persisted in step state, not only declared dataset bindings.

cause: Real DeepSeek evaluation of the v1.8.8 chain Agent (20 turns, 7 confirmed executions) exposed contract and UX gaps not covered by deterministic tests.
impact: 15/20 full success; a model.rerun of measurement_level on a column outside the model completed while leaving the model unchanged, which misleads the user; one empty answer; most proposal turns end in English.
lesson: Deterministic planner scores do not reveal silent no-op effects; confirmed execution must be checked against the declared expected effect.

cause: model.rerun accepted a labels-only patch naming columns outside the model, and the Agent RerunService lacked the absent-column guard that only the HTTP route applied.
impact: A confirmed operation completed with a model identical to its parent while its proposal claimed the column was added.
lesson: Validation shared by multiple execution paths must live in the shared service and also run at proposal time.

cause: execute_genesis_draft JSON-encoded all dict model params, turning labels into text rejected downstream.
impact: Every model.genesis step declaring measurement levels failed with MODEL_OPTIONS_NOT_OBJECT in shipped v1.8.8.
lesson: Form synthesis must use the one shared field encoder rather than a local re-implementation.

cause: Step 4 delivered user-missing codes, labelled coefficient terms across report/table/export, and Agent read/edit of declared metadata.
impact: Live DeepSeek: relabel and missing-code requests execute after one visible self-correction; browser Table view shows labelled region levels and educ N=292 with 6 declared-missing. Metadata editing UI moves to step 6 (variable view).
lesson: Refusals raised from Agent tools must be ToolVisibleError or the model sees only the type name and loops.
